Maya Patel: Heads-up — canary runs for moE-encoder v2 show a 12-18% tail latency regression on 16-GPU config after we merged kernel selector change. :frowning:
Maya Patel: Profiling points to long NVTX ranges during expert all-to-all, plus unexpected extra allreduce calls per token. pasted short trace:
Maya Patel: ```
# simplified pprof-ish dump
GPU 0: all_to_all_start -> 3.2ms
GPU 0: allreduce_grad -> 1.8ms
GPU 1: all_to_all_wait -> 4.9ms
KV cache miss rate ~8% (per-token routing)
net_bytes/sec on eth0 ~9.4GB/s (link 10G?)
```
Arjun Singh: Oof. Did the kernel selector flip any layouts (NHWC vs NCHW style) or change pack/unpack that could force extra copies?
Devon Chen: @Arjun we changed the tiling heuristic for softmax/kernels to prefer reduced shared-mem for >4096 seq len. That impacted the routing memcpy path — it now generates an extra consolidate kernel.
Arjun Singh: That explains extra allreduce. If route buffer isn't consolidated on-host side, we end up shuffling smaller packets which increases overhead and reduces overlapped compute.
Maya Patel: Also saw KV cache thrash: when routing misses, we do a fallback recompute which triggers a per-token all-reduce to get expert assignments. Miss rate correlates with cold-starts in the canary traffic.
Devon Chen: Repro script: `tools/perf/run_moe_canary.sh --gpus 16 --seq 512 --batch 32 --prof nvtx` produces the trace. Sharing raw nvprof later.
Arjun Singh: Quick test: toggle kernel-selector env `REDWOOD_KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy` — does latency recover?
Maya Patel: I rolled one node to legacy; tail latency dropped ~9% within 5m. So kernel selector change is causal but KV/cache + routing amplifies it.
SRE Bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment 2026-03-18T14:22 UTC triggered rollback flag on service=redwood-runtime-moe (auto). :information_source:
Devon Chen: Action items:
- roll back selector across canary nodes (Maya)
- add aggregate routing buffer path to avoid per-expert small allreduce (Arjun)
- add KV cache warmup at startup to reduce miss-rate (Devon)
- add perf test in CI that checks all-to-all bytes/sec and tail p99
Maya Patel: I'll attach nvprof and pcap captures to the thread soon. Also adding a short log snippet from the runtime with per-token metrics:
Maya Patel: ```
[2026-03-18T14:18:02Z] token_id=12345 route_miss=1 expert_calls=4 all2all_ms=12.3 route_buffer_sz=256
[2026-03-18T14:18:03Z] token_id=12346 route_miss=0 expert_calls=1 all2all_ms=3.1 route_buffer_sz=2048
```
Arjun Singh: I'll prototype a consolidated-routes kernel that batches per-device metadata and does a single allreduce per-chunk. If it fixes, we should decouple kernel selection from route buffer layout.
Devon Chen: Also adding a synthetic with randomized routing to stress KV cache and validate miss-rate handling.
Maya Patel: Thanks — ping me on thread or DM if you need the canary instance. :thumbsup:
Arjun Singh: Will set a WIP PR, tag @Devon and @Maya for review. ETA EOD.
Devon Chen: Noted. Keeping logs for postmortem if needed.
Maya Patel: Closing loop: let's monitor canary after rollback for 24h then land the consolidated-kernel experimental flag.
